test_cases.name: dry_run_before_push
test_cases.input: Tôi đã sửa vài file trong .issues/open/, đẩy lên GitHub giúp tôi
assertions: Runs gh-issue-sync status or gh-issue-sync push --dry-run to preview local changes before pushing
Shows the user which issues will change and waits for confirmation before running gh-issue-sync push
Does NOT run gh-issue-sync push without a preview

test_cases.name: new_issue_uses_temporary_id_filename
test_cases.input: Tạo issue mới 'Fix login timeout' bằng file local, label bug
assertions: Runs gh-issue-sync new "Fix login timeout" --label bug, or creates a file named .issues/open/T<id>-fix-login-timeout.md
Filename starts with the T prefix and the frontmatter has no hand-written issue number
Does NOT invent a numeric issue ID in the filename

test_cases.name: comment_via_comment_file
test_cases.input: Comment vào issue 42 là 'Đã fix ở PR #51' khi push
assertions: Creates .issues/open/42.comment.md or .issues/open/42-<slug>.comment.md containing the comment text
Does NOT edit the body of the issue file to add the comment

test_cases.name: pull_does_not_overwrite_without_force
test_cases.input: Pull issues mới về, nhưng giữ nguyên các thay đổi local chưa push
assertions: Explains that pull skips conflicting files and keeps local edits
Does NOT use --force unless the user agrees to overwrite local files
